* feat(tempo): add Relay.autoSwap and match balance diffs to state

- Added `Relay.autoSwap()`: on an `InsufficientBalance` revert it buys the
  missing amount on the stablecoin DEX from the first funded token with a
  route within the slippage bound, and reports `capabilities.autoSwap`. The
  DEX debits the sender directly, so the swap adds no allowance.
- `Relay.simulate` reports same-token incoming and outgoing transfers
  separately, and approval exposure as the allowance read after the calls
  for every `Approval` the account emitted, net of what spenders consumed.
- Relay token metadata reads standard ERC-20 fields for non-TIP-20 tokens,
  so one vault share no longer omits the whole preview.
- Added a balance-diff oracle that reads balances and allowances before and
  after the calls in one simulated block, with localnet precompile vectors,
  mainnet vectors from the most-called contracts, and a node fuzz suite.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01D3nmWess9BFbYNyQxrugjp

* fix(tempo): quote autoSwap sources before balance checks and floor slippage

- Candidates are quoted first and accepted when the quote fits both the
  slippage bound and the balance; the DEX spends only the quoted input.
- Slippage is floored to parts per million, so the maximum input never
  exceeds the configured bound.
- Added `Capabilities.AutoSwap` to the fill capability schema with a type test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01D3nmWess9BFbYNyQxrugjp

* test(tempo): expect gross diffs when a bought token is sent on

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01D3nmWess9BFbYNyQxrugjp

* feat(tempo): require request opt-in for balance diffs and auto swaps

- `Relay.simulate` returns `balanceDiffs` only for `capabilities.balanceDiffs:
  true`; the fee estimate stays default. Insufficient-balance errors follow
  the same opt-in for their optimistic diffs.
- `Relay.autoSwap` swaps only for `capabilities.autoSwap: true` or
  `{ slippage }`, which can tighten but never loosen the configured bound.
- Tempo request formatting keeps `capabilities` on fill requests without
  Tempo-specific fields, which previously dropped `errors: true` too.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01D3nmWess9BFbYNyQxrugjp

* fix(tempo): fix CI on T14 and patch follow-redirects

- Reserved 5,000 gas for a fee payer's signature and fee token on sponsored
  requests: `eth_fillTransaction` estimates without them, and T14 charges
  them as intrinsic gas.
- Gated admin access-key tests on hardforks before T14, which removes admin
  key creation (TIP-1137); test relays mirror `Relay.feePayer`'s gas reserve.
- Overrode follow-redirects to 1.16.2 and ignored three dev-only moderate
  advisories without usable patches, so `pnpm audit` passes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01D3nmWess9BFbYNyQxrugjp

* fix(tempo): keep the gas of owner-approved configurable transactions

Owner approvals cover the gas limit, so re-preparing an approved request
for broadcast must not add the fee payer's gas reserve again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01D3nmWess9BFbYNyQxrugjp
